parameters.help_en: The minimum time-to-live (TTL) for cached data retrieved from the origin server. The value ranges from 30 to 86400
parameters.help_zh: 回源缓存数据TTL(最小值)，取值范围为30 - 86400
parameters.name: cache_ttl_min

parameters.help_en: The maximum TTL for cached data retrieved from the origin server. The value ranges from 30 to 86400
parameters.help_zh: 回源缓存数据TTL(最大值)，取值范围为30 - 86400
parameters.name: cache_ttl_max

parameters.help_en: The origin protocol. Valid values: TCP and UDP. Default value: UDP
parameters.name: source_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin server supports Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS).
SUPPORT: The origin server supports EDNS.
NOT_SUPPORT: The origin server does not support EDNS
parameters.help_zh:
源站是否支持edns。
NOT_SUPPORT：不支持，SUPPORT：支持
parameters.name: source_edns

fields.help_en: The domain name or IP address of the origin server
fields.help_zh: 源站服务器的域名或IP地址
fields.name: host

fields.help_en: The port of the origin DNS server
fields.name: port

parameters.help_en: A list of origin DNS servers. You can add up to 10 servers
parameters.help_zh: 源站DNS服务器列表，最多支持添加10条记录
